svg.text: Gcd(12, 8) Is the Unique Number Whose Divisor Strip Matches CD(12, 8)
Refinement type: Gcd(12, 8) = { g ∈ ℕ │ Div(g) = Div(12) ∩ Div(8) }
Navy pin seated in purple socket (d | g and d ∈ CD)
Resulting Refinement Type on the Value Line: Gcd(12, 8) = { g ∈ ℕ │ Div(g) = {1, 2, 4} } = { 4 }
Out of all natural numbers g ∈ ℕ, only g = 4 has divisor strip {1, 2, 4}. The refinement carves out a singleton subset:
